Families come in all shapes and styles — and being different is what makes you unique!

Today's Read Aloud Storytime is a classic fairy tale, "The Elves and the Shoemaker," retold from the Brothers Grimm and illustrated by Jim LaMarche. Join us as we discover how tiny elves help a poor shoemaker and his wife, turning their luck around with their secret nighttime work. Filled with kindness, gratitude, and a touch of magic, this story is perfect for kids and families.
